# 143 — PR explainer (HIGH tier: full walkthrough + quiz)

## Goal
Stop the "Garden this pool →" CTA — one of the two north-star events (`pool_click{source=garden_cta}`) — from dumping the user onto a planner that **falsely claims a third party sent them the garden**, and stop that same arrival from firing a bogus `share_link_opened` event that pollutes the viral-loop metric. Both are the moat's problem: trust is the conversion currency, and a lie at the conversion moment is the most expensive lie.

## Intuition (the one thing to understand)
The planner has exactly one "prefilled arrival" code path, built originally (item 007) for people who open a **shared** garden link. Its trigger is `sharedPlan = decodePlanFromUrl(urlParams)` — truthy whenever the URL carries `goal`+`pace`+`capital`/`monthly`. The "Garden this pool" CTA deep-links into the planner with the **exact same param shape**. So the planner literally could not distinguish "a stranger shared this with you" from "you just clicked Garden-this-pool on our own pool page." It assumed the former for both, and showed *"Someone sent you this garden"* / *"Someone shared their garden — make it yours"* to a user who shared nothing.

The fix is to make the two paths distinguishable with a single marker and branch honestly.

## What changed and why (diff in reading order)

1. **`PoolDetail.js:253`** — `gardenThisPoolHref` gains `&src=pool`. One definition, feeding both the hero CTA (:555) and the repeat-footer CTA (:1626). This is the only signal the planner needs.

2. **`planner.js:4075`** — `var poolSourced = !!sharedPlan && urlParams.get('src') === 'pool';`. Gated on `sharedPlan` first, so it is inert on every non-deep-link load. Genuine share links (built by `buildShareUrl`) never carry `src`, so they are cleanly excluded.

3. **`planner.js:4079–4084`** — the `trackShareLinkOpened` effect now early-returns when `poolSourced` (deps updated to `[sharedPlan, poolSourced]`). A pool-CTA arrival is a self-initiated click already counted as `pool_click{source=garden_cta}` on the pool page — counting it again as a *share open* would double-count and inflate the viral metric with non-share traffic.

4. **`planner.js:3806` (ArrivalBanner) + `:4358` (goal-step intro) + `:4746–4748` (bloom intro)** — each renders the `...Pool` copy variant when `poolSourced`, else the original share copy. The prefilled plan, the "Make it mine" button, and the bloom fast-forward are untouched — only the attribution sentence changes.

5. **`planner.js:1001` (`encodePlanToUrl`/`buildShareUrl`)** — `u.searchParams.delete('src')` alongside the existing `delete('preset')/delete('fresh')`. `u` is built from `window.location.href`, so a user who arrived via `?src=pool` and then shares their plan must emit a **clean** share URL — otherwise their recipient would get the pool-sourced copy instead of the real "someone shared" arrival.

6. **`translations.js`** — `arrivalBannerTextPool` + `sharedPlanIntroPool` added in **both** EN and KO, honest (no "someone/sent/shared" / "누군가/보냈/공유"), meaning-matched.

7. **Regenerated artifacts** (`PoolDetail.compiled.js`, `PoolDetail.compiled.min.js`, `planner.min.js`, `translations.min.js`) via `compile-app.js` + `minify-assets.js`. `home.html` serves the compiled PoolDetail artifact, so without this the `&src=pool` change would not reach the rendered page (the first Playwright run proved it — the arrival landed without the marker until the artifact was refreshed). Generators only; no hand-editing.

8. **`package.json`** — new `test_garden_cta_arrival.js` appended to the `test` chain.

## Acceptance (rendered Playwright, `test_garden_cta_arrival.js`, verifier-re-run 8/8)
Scenario 1 (pool CTA): clicks the real CTA → lands on `...&src=pool` → NO "Someone sent/shared" copy, honest "prefilled from the pool" copy present, `$` projection renders, `share_link_opened` NOT fired.
Scenario 2 (genuine share, no `src=pool`): STILL shows "Someone sent/shared" AND fires `share_link_opened` — item 007 preserved.

## Deviations from spec
See `143-notes.md`: (1) regenerating compiled/min artifacts (mandatory, not in the spec's file list); (2) `delete('src')` placed in `encodePlanToUrl` (load-bearing). Both logged.

## Risk & tests
- Risk tier **HIGH** (verifier concurred, independently): small ~28-line diff touching **no** trust rail / router / SEO / dependency / config, but it introduces conditional arrival-flow branching + an analytics-firing condition change → "user-facing beyond copy/styling", and "when in doubt → HIGH".
- `npm test` is not a CI gate here (no workflow runs it; only `sitemap-update.yml` exists) and it halts at the **pre-existing** `test_minified_assets.js` failure (reproduced at HEAD via git stash, unrelated to this diff). Affected tests verified individually: garden_cta_arrival 8/8, northstar_cta_fires 7/7, repeat_cta 5/5, report_share 8/8, share_mix_roundtrip 5/5, translations_fallback 8/8, compiled_assets 4/4.
- Ships needing **human visual spot-check** of the pool-CTA planner arrival copy (render-path merge; smoke gate 003 covers structure, not this copy branch).
